name: MKX 1 Gram 510 Thread Carts *LIMITED EDITION* - Raspberry Apricot (Sativa)
description:
Raspberry Apricot (S) – 2025 Winter Collection
Juicy, tangy, and fruit-forward, Raspberry Apricot delivers a bright burst of flavorful energy. Part of the 5 limited strains in the 2025 Winter Collection, this sativa vape blends sweet raspberries and ripe apricots for an invigorating, uplifting experience.

The #1 selling vape cartridge on the market, MKX Carts deliver an activated, award-winning THC oil with the highest THC level possible and sensational flavor. Our strain library is constantly adapting to introduce exciting new terpenes and flavors.
